chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 58 – Ji Ning's Gambling Duel: First Blood in Anchan City
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning steps into the Wuyou Caverns for his first gambling duel. Facing a rhinoceros great demon with Heavenly Transformation, he unleashes the Water-Fire Lotus and silences a hall of mocking nobles.
og_title: Desolate Era – First Blood in Anchan City
og_description: A monstrous genius emerges. Ji Ning defeats a rhinoceros great demon with twelve Water-Fire Lotuses, shocking the nobles of Anchan City.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 58 – Ji Ning crushes a mountain-sized demon
twitter_description: Ji Ning's career in Anchan City begins with a decapitation and a lotus bloom. Pure Xianxia catharsis.
